newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK bourse says 2nd board study in very early stage.
newsitem.headline: HK bourse says 2nd board study in very early stage.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong's said on Friday its study on setting up a second board for smaller companies was still at a very preliminary stage.
"We don't want to hasten the issue to make it as if it would happen very soon," deputy chief executive Herbert Hui said.

"Actually our study is still very preliminary and all I can say is a lot of people provided ideas to us saying that a second board is feasible," Hui, who is also head of listings at the exchange, told reporters.

He said the idea of setting up a second board to encourage the listing of high-technology firms was a good one, but that the exchange was also considering how to help high-tech firms seek a listing on the main board.
